post_stratification_read.channel: scripts/flights/comp1/milestone_successor1_read.sh passes --strata-source scorer --population-counts docs/readiness/2026-10-01-slurp-milestone-successor1-v1/population-counts-v1.json --weighting post-stratified; scripts/analysis/stage3_paired_read.py runs the official-scoring step's --strata-inside-scorer mode (src/speech_aware_evidence_acquisition/core/scoring_strata.py, exported by core.scoring_batch) in its OWN process; that process reads gold through the slurp-slu-official-test binding (reproduction.slurp_official_eval.official_gold_intents), in memory, after both seals, and the read process never sees a per-row stratum.
post_stratification_read.emitted: ONE file, scorer-strata-aggregate.json (schema saea-scorer-strata-aggregate-v1) in the read's analysis root: per stratum n_h and, per arm, intent_correct_h, TP_h, FP_h, FN_h (per-intent aggregate counts, the form the roster receipt publishes) plus the per-stratum deltas and CI95s; the raw, post-stratified and equal-stratum deltas and CI95s; the population weights; input hashes (both score files, roster, population counts); a canonical receipt_sha256. The read driver verifies every hash, the seed, draws and cluster key before reporting.

formulas.equal_stratum: the unweighted mean over the 58 carried strata of the per-stratum deltas
formulas.intent_post_stratified: sum_h w_h * mean_h(scenario_action_exact) per arm, then arm minus MILESTONE-SUCCESSOR1-PLAN; w_h = N_h / sum over the 58 carried strata of N_h
formulas.raw: the roster's own mixture (labelled 'raw roster mean (not a population estimate)'; never the natural_mixture slot on this floored roster); must equal the read driver's own contrast bit for bit or the read refuses
formulas.slu_f1_post_stratified: F1(sum_h w_h*TP_h/n_h, sum_h w_h*FP_h/n_h, sum_h w_h*FN_h/n_h) per arm, then arm minus MILESTONE-SUCCESSOR1-PLAN -- the per-stratum TP/FP/FN totals are weighted before the F1 formula, never each stratum's own F1

never_written: any row-level output pairing a sample id or utterance id with a gold field

utterance text, transcripts or model output
post_stratification_read.refusals: the scorer step refuses before gold is touched: a scorer id outside the official SLURP bindings, a roster receipt without a stratification block, an existing or non-.json output, scored rows that are not exactly the roster, and any per-row output flag; it refuses to write a receipt whose bytes carry a roster sample id.
post_stratification_read.resampling: 10,000 draws, seed 20260929, prompt clusters (utterance_id) resampled WITHIN gold-intent strata (each stratum to its own size, strata in ascending name order, one fresh random.Random(seed) per bootstrap), both arms' rows matched by sample_id inside the scorer process; the same shared estimators (analysis.stratified_paired) the gold-bank path uses, so both paths draw identical bootstrap indices
post_stratification_read.ruling: coordinator ruling 2026-09-30: the roster receipt allows gold only as 'per-intent aggregate counts only; no label beside a sample id' (decision 141 item 5) and the allowance lets gold be read 'ONLY by the official scorer, after delivery'; a per-row gold bank is therefore not a legal channel (the DRAFT row SAEA-SLURP-TEST-SAMPLE-3010-GOLD-BANK-V1 on the unmerged branch fable/samplegoldbank is NOT PURSUED). Post-stratification happens INSIDE the official-scoring step and emits AGGREGATES ONLY.
post_stratification_read.strata: gold intent scenario_action: 59 strata in the population counts (full-test recording counts, total 13,078, from the roster receipt's per_intent table); 58 carried by the sample (general_greet is closure-only), so the post-stratified weights are renormalised over those 58 and general_greet is reported as a dropped stratum.
post_stratification_read.tests: tests/unit/test_scoring_batch_strata_inside_scorer.py and tests/unit/test_stage3_paired_read.py (scorer path equals the gold-bank path float for float on the floored two-stratum fake: raw +25 / post-stratified +90 / equal-stratum +50 pp; no file pairs a sample id with a stratum); equivalence on the sealed TRAIN Fold A pair recorded in the commit that landed this block.
